## Select data frame verbs

```{r example-multichoice-options, echo=FALSE}
q_example_multichoice_options <- c("filter", "select", "lm", "hist")
q_example_multichoice_answer <- c("filter", "select")
```

Which names are dplyr verbs used to subset a data frame? Select all that apply.

**Answer:** `r quiz_multichoice(q_example_multichoice_answer, q_example_multichoice_options)`

::: unilur-solution
`filter()` subsets rows and `select()` subsets columns.
:::
